title: session.start@3
description: A session started, with which billing keys its agent had set.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the hook appends this kind: an adapter maps its agent's events from hook payloads.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

billing.description: Whether each billing key is set in the environment the agent gave deep-hook, by name: true or false, never a value.

loads.description: What the session loads at its start: the instruction files, skills, hook settings and MCP servers, each with the digest of its files, and each server with its tool list.

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

name.description: The skill's or server's name, or the file's name.

source.description: Where it is loaded from: its file, or for a server the config that names it.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of its files, or of a server's config entry.

tools.description: A server's tools, as the session's facts list them; absent when unknown.

toolLoad.description: What the session holds of DeepBuild's own MCP servers at its start, both ways (#2897): by search, the tools' names, the servers' instructions, the tools marked to load up front and the skill's description; whole, every tool's schema and the skill. The way is its client's, from its agent's facts, and a reader charges that count; unread charges neither. Both counts are of the pair deep setup writes, deepbuild and deep-actions, recorded for a Claude Code session whose config loads deepbuild. Before the session's version is read, its facts' newest version gives the way.

way.description: How its client loads an MCP server's tools.

x-closure.closed: the two ways a client is known to load a server's tools, and not read
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

startTokens.description: Tokens a client that loads by search holds at the start, by the pinned tokenizer.

wholeTokens.description: Tokens a client that loads the whole list holds at the start, by the pinned tokenizer.
